about: Every port a viewer's browser connects to, by address family and mode. The only declaration: the host agent allocates from it (src/fleet/agent/ports.rs), the viewer-path smoke checks each published URL against it (fleet/coord/stage-smoke.py), and ejc3/aws derives the GPU hosts' security group from it. A GPU host publishes every place on its one public IPv4 address at gpu_host_ipv4.sni_port, routed by TLS server name (src/fleet/agent/sni.rs) to the place's own listener at gpu_host_ipv4.base (the agent's --tls-publish-base) plus the place's offset in its mode's range plus its index there. Those per-place ports were published to viewers before sni_port and stay open to them until every host runs an image with the front (fleet/PROTOCOL.md, "The IPv4 front").

ranges.what: a GPU slot: a wall renderer or a phone, by its GPU's index in the host's inventory
a Windows sandbox's bridge, by the sandbox's index on its host
a Minecraft server's view socket, by the server's index on its host
